mcp_server: Reliable Collaboration's unofficial NetBox read/write MCP server
scope: Native CLI harnesses using DeepInfra GLM-5.3-Flash through LiteLLM, MCP 0.4.1 release and 0.4.2 candidate; real NetBox 4.7.2
limits: Targeted acceptance, not a statistical model reliability benchmark.
Does not qualify native Anthropic or OpenAI models, desktop clients, or OpenCode 2.
Preservation checks cover 15 inventory collections and scenario-specific assertions, not a whole-database diff.
Native client tool-output truncation is not measured.
qualified_passed includes stricter successful trace/search checks; original reports are preserved even if their weaker checks passed.
The Community prompt names API paths and actions to force coverage; the inventory prompt describes desired records and relationships.
Tool-error counts are top-level MCP errors; rejected items inside bulk/workflow responses are reflected separately in journal operation states.

Claude run 236807be64 predates reporting refinements: its recorded 160-step limit was not applied; the phase time limit was active. Host-tool and usage review was performed from its original transcript.
